mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.category_id, a.title, a.content, a.cover_image, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.username, u.nickname, c.name as category_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.category_id, a.title, a.content, a.cover_image, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.username, u.nickname, c.name as category_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1
AND MATCH(a.title, a.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
